_comment: Locale classification + decrease-only shortfall ledger for i18n-key-parity-gate.mjs. `mandatoryLocales` ship at 100% of the reference key set (the union of every mandatory locale's leaf keys) -- any hole fails --check and there is NO baseline escape for them. `declaredPartialLocales` ship incomplete BY DECISION; their `missing` count is a decrease-only CEILING: growth fails --check, a NEW partial locale with no entry fails --check, and a shrink reports a tighten opportunity (run --seed to lower the ceiling). Every locale in SUPPORTED_LOCALES must appear in exactly one of the two lists.

fr.reason: French landed as a partial catalog: the `common`/`errors`/`validation` namespaces and the older `components` families are translated, the component families added after the initial French drop are not. Recorded as accepted debt at the WO-I18N landing so the hole can only shrink; French is not wired as a mandatory product locale.

pt.reason: Portuguese landed as a partial catalog alongside French and carries the identical hole (same untranslated component families). Recorded as accepted debt at the WO-I18N landing so the hole can only shrink; Portuguese is not wired as a mandatory product locale.
